questions.q: What types of partners does Bishnoi Omniverse work with?
questions.a: Two categories — distribution partners (organizations seeking to distribute our hospital supply or specialty medicine lines in their market) and manufacturer partners (manufacturers seeking sourcing and distribution reach into markets we serve directly).

questions.q: What markets do you currently operate in?
questions.a: Our two operating hubs are in New Delhi, India (sourcing) and Metro Manila, Philippines (Asia-Pacific logistics), with delivery reach into more than 50 countries.

questions.q: What is the process to become a partner?
questions.a: Send an inquiry through the partnership form linked from this page. Our team reviews fit against the markets and product categories in scope, then follows up directly to begin documentation review.

questions.q: What documentation do manufacturer partners need to provide?
questions.a: At minimum, evidence of the certification relevant to the product category — WHO-GMP for pharmaceuticals, CE/CMDR or equivalent for devices — and, where applicable, Certificates of Analysis for specific batches.
